narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Add the gates. Three plus five plus seven gives fifteen cows.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Try fifteen cows at the seven gates, and some gates get two cows while others get one.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>The groups are not equal, so that slip is struck.
removed_beats.on_screen: the slip's bubble shows 3 + 5 + 7 = 15; fifteen cows are drawn in the seven gates and one gate stays short; the slip's bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>To check, divide the number of cows by each gate count.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>One hundred and five divided by three is thirty five, and by five is twenty one.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Divided by seven it is fifteen, so every gate gets a whole number of cows.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the check lines 105 / 3 = 35, 105 / 5 = 21 and 105 / 7 = 15 appear with ticks

old_misconception.wrong_move: A common slip adds three, five and seven to get fifteen cows. Fifteen cows cannot pass seven gates in equal groups, so it fails the third crossing.
